verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users converse with Copilot to search code, ask questions about repos, assign issues to Copilot for automated PR creation, and manage Copilot cloud agent tasks—covering browse, search, and a form of edit/commit/PR creation via natural language. However, there's no evidence of a full conversational agent loop that also handles pull/push git operations or arbitrary file edits directly through chat; PR creation is Copilot's autonomous action rather than user-directed commit/pull/push. Missing for 10: explicit pull/push-via-conversation capability, hands-on confirmation of the full browse-to-push agent workflow, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
